svg.title: Card fraud platform: overview
svg.desc: Layer 1: DP1 copies the core banking tables, the nightly export and Flink's raw payment files into bronze, the export through a lakeFS branch merged only after the checks pass; the DP2 silver and gold pipelines and DP3 each read one zone and write the next; Flink jobs turn Kafka events into live features and alerts; Feast keeps the features offline for training and online for scoring. Layer 2: the Scoring API decides each payment with the KServe model and logs the decision; KServe's logger feeds the Drift API through a Knative broker; the training pipeline registers every model in MLflow. Layer 3: the support chat, the agents, the MCP tool servers and the model servers all meet at agentgateway.
svg.text: The bank's data comes in on the left. Layer 1 turns it into clean tables and features. In Layer 2 a model scores every card payment in real time
and is retrained when the data drifts. In Layer 3 agents answer the support staff's questions about a card, with the same data.
